name: janitor-fix
tagline_zh: 技能库乱成一团？斜杠命令一键体检，先安全预览再修复，还能顺手清掉坏链接、空文件夹和孤儿技能，不留后患。
tagline_en: Slash command to audit & fix skills safely—preview first, then repair, prune broken links, empty dirs, and orphans.
desc_en: Automatically fix skill problems (safe preview first). Also use with --prune to find and remove broken symlinks, empty directories, and orphaned skills. Trigger with '/janitor-fix'.
why_zh: 同类工具只报错，它先给安全预览再动手，还能精准清理三类垃圾，修复不误伤。
why_en: Unlike others, it previews before fixing and prunes broken links, empty dirs, and orphans without collateral damage.
